title: Master Premier Cup
rules: No CP limit.
Legendary Pokémon, Mythical Pokémon, and Ultra Beasts are not eligible.

title: Love Cup
rules: Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
Only red- or pink-colored Pokémon are eligible.

title: Mega Master League
rules: No CP limit.
Mega-Evolved Pokémon are allowed.

title: EUIC 2026 Championship Series Cup
rules: Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
Only Bug-, Dark-, Normal-, and Dragon-type Pokémon are eligible.
Fighting-, Flying-, and Steel-type Pokémon are not eligible.
Legendary Pokémon, Mythical Pokémon, Mega Pokémon, and Ultra Beasts are not eligible.
The following Pokémon will be allowed: Seaking, Politoed, Milotic, and Froslass.
The following Pokémon will not be allowed: Wigglytuff, CHansey, Crustle, Diggersby, Ribombee, Araquanid, Turtonator, Morgrem, Morpeko

title: Kanto Cup
rules: Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
Only Pokémon with a Pokédex number from #001 to #151 are eligible.

title: Spring Cup
rules: Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
Only Water-, Grass-, and Fairy-type Pokémon are eligible.
Jumpluff, Roserade, and Toxapex are not eligible.

title: Jungle Cup
rules: Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
Only Normal-, Grass-, Electric-, Poison-, Ground-, Flying-, Bug-, and Dark-type Pokémon are eligible.

title: Electric Cup
rules: Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
Only Electric-type Pokémon are eligible.
Stunfisk, Heliolisk, Charjabug, and Vikavolt are not eligible.

title: Fantasy Cup
rules: Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
Only Dragon-, Steel-, and Fairy-type Pokémon are eligible.

title: Catch Cup: Memories in Motion
rules: Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
Only Pokémon caught from March 3 to June 2, 2026, are eligible.
